beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part four of the Musinique mark. The physics set: sinusoid wobble, a heavy elastic spring that squashes on impact, a card flip that swaps faces at ninety degrees, and shadow play. Weight is the whole trick here.
Your turn. Paste this: drop my logo with a heavy elastic spring — squash it four percent on impact — then flip it like a card and tell me which read matches a music brand.
Musinique, in motion. Part four. Liam, in for Bear.
